# Skin Restore

> Medical-grade skin care in San Clemente, California. A single licensed
> esthetician — Demi Broughton, licensed esthetician #Z91680, 15+ years
> in aesthetics, former Skincare Director at Platinum Medical Spa in Aliso Viejo.

Location: 312 Avenida de la Estrella, San Clemente, CA 92672
Phone: (949) 545-7919
Hours: By appointment only — Tuesday to Saturday, 10am to 6pm
Serving: San Clemente, Dana Point, San Juan Capistrano, Laguna Niguel, Orange County

## Treatments
- [DiamondGlow](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/diamondglow): 3-in-1 exfoliation, extraction and serum infusion. No downtime.
- [Micro Channeling / Nano Needling](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/microchanneling): collagen induction for texture, fine lines and firmness. Microchanneling, nano needling and nano infusion are the same treatment here.
- [Wonder Touch RF](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/rf-skin-tightening): radiofrequency skin tightening, non-surgical, no downtime.
- [BREEZE Cryo Oxygen](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/oxygen-facial): needle-free hydroporation with lymphatic drainage and nutrient infusion.
- [Cool Restore Cryo](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/cryo-facial): controlled cryo cooling to firm, de-puff and calm.
- [Teen Facial](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/teen-facial): acne-focused facial for teenagers with professional extractions.
- [DermaPlane](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/dermaplaning): physical exfoliation of dead skin and vellus hair.
- [BioRePeel](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/biorepeel): 35% TCA biphasic peel with minimal visible peeling.
- [Back Facial](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/back-facial): cleansing, exfoliation and extractions for back breakouts and congestion.
- [Brow Tint](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/brow-tint): semi-permanent brow tinting, shade matched to your coloring.
- [Chemical Peels](https://www.skinrestoreoc.com/chemical-peels): mild to moderate peels for tone, texture and pigmentation.
